problems.quote: including by India through the National Policy on Human Resource Development for Civil Services
problems.problem: No such policy exists by that name. India's civil service reforms have been guided by various initiatives (e.g., National Training Policy 2012, Mission Karmayogi 2020), but there is no "National Policy on Human Resource Development for Civil Services".
problems.correction: including by India through various civil service reform initiatives
problems.verifierReason: No policy titled 'National Policy on Human Resource Development for Civil Services' exists; reforms are via various initiatives.
